civilopediaText.text: FFH2/ExtraModMod: Adepts require Knowledge of the Ether and a Mage Guild. Gain experience, learn sphere promotions where you have the corresponding mana, and eventually upgrade to a Mage (Wizard for Amurites).

civilopediaText.text: Tier-three arcane unit. Train an Adept, research Sorcery, then upgrade it; direct construction is disabled. ExtraModMod's level-four upgrade restriction is not yet expressible with this Unciv mod's current rules.

Amurite Mage replacement. Train an Adept and upgrade after Sorcery. Spellstaff's additional-cast mechanic and original level-four requirement remain pending; the promotion currently preserves its original identity.

Amurite hero from ExtraModMod: a powerful arcane teacher available with Arcane Lore. Limited to one active unit here; one-time-ever creation and spell teaching need additional native Unciv behavior.
Amurite Assassin replacement from ExtraModMod. Full Dimensional magic and special stealth interactions are pending.

ExtraModMod Death I summon: a permanent undead warrior. Summon with an Adept or Wizard that has Death I. This early Unciv prototype caps skeletons at three living units per civilization instead of the canonical one-per-eligible-caster limit; summon inheritance and the graveyard triple-summon effect are not yet implemented.
